snippet.title: VOIDBORN 1.0 - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Voidborn 1.0 is coming on April 7! (moved from April 4th)
Wishlist to get notified on release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072660

Music by @stillcrisp 

Slay demons and demigods in this fast-paced roguelite FPS. Create devastating weapon builds as you journey through massive dark fantasy environments on your quest to avenge god. Challenge the demigods, face inevitable death, and rise stronger with every rebirth.
